note: Medicine Bow NF campground on the Pole Mountain unit off Happy Jack Road east of Laramie: one loop of 19 sites under conifers and aspen, with pedestal grills and fire rings, beside the Tie City mountain bike and ski trails. Horse corrals sit outside the campground. Pay at the self-pay station. --Claude
